definitions.explanation: Describes speaking, reading, or doing something without stumbling or pausing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すらすら⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
すらすらと⟦{答|こた}えられた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to answer smoothly.

examples.japanese: この⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すらすら⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: This book is easy to read smoothly.

notes:
すらすら is an onomatopoeic adverb describing smooth, uninterrupted flow, particularly in speech, reading, or writing. Can be used with or without the particle と (すらすらと).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すらすら⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak fluently
- すらすら⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read smoothly
- すらすら⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write smoothly
- すらすら⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer without hesitation
- すらすらと⟦{出|で}てくる→出る：00513_deru⟧: to come out smoothly (ideas, words)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぺらぺら→ぺらぺら：05256_perapera⟧: fluently (often implies showing off or superficiality)
- ⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧: smoothly flowing (more for physical movement, texture, or writing)
- ⟦スムーズ→スムーズ：11024_sumuuzu⟧に: smoothly (loanword, broader usage beyond speech/reading)

USAGE:
すらすら focuses on the absence of stumbling or hesitation. It implies skill or ease, and is always positive.
